menu.title: Foul Fowl: Fly, Flock, Forage, Fight
menu.quit_confirm: This is the door. One More Turn is a different button, and it appears after you have already won.
credits.1: For eXplorminate, with affection: a small galaxy, a finished evening, and the swans exactly as guilty as charged.
credits.2: No balance patch was applied to the swans. This was a decision.
menu.preset.tiny.name: Tiny
menu.preset.evening_standard.name: Evening Standard
menu.preset.evening_standard.sub: Twenty-four stars. One sitting. Bedtime intact if you are honest.
menu.preset.evening_standard.seats: Swans, one early-war bird, one schemer. Take one of those seats and the chair refills.
menu.toggle.seat_swans.tip: Checked by default. Unchecking it is a setting.
difficulty.nestling.name: Nestling
difficulty.nestling.tip: The AI is smaller, and polite about it. It will not come for you first. The card says -25% industry and research.
difficulty.flighted.name: Flighted
difficulty.flighted.tip: No gifts to either side. If you lose, it is yours.
difficulty.honk_admiral.name: Honk Admiral
difficulty.honk_admiral.tip: The AI receives the printed bonuses and may read your ship designs. Be angry at a number. The number is listed.
difficulty.lights_off_ledger.name: Lights-Off Ledger
difficulty.lights_off_ledger.tip: +40% industry, +40% research, +20% growth, your designs, your colonies, your fleets. Every modifier is printed. None of them are gentle.
race.swans.name: The Pale Supremacy
race.swans.pitch: Better than you at the thing you were about to do, and already bored of the demonstration.
race.pheasants.name: The Ringneck Warrant
race.pheasants.pitch: A victory lap that learned to file flight plans.
race.ducks.name: The Dabble League
race.ducks.pitch: If it has a shoreline, they have a rate card.
race.geese.name: The Marked Airspace
race.geese.pitch: They were here first. The property line was the honk.
race.owls.name: The Night Parliament
race.owls.pitch: They have read the tree. They are waiting on you to finish the tutorial.
race.penguins.name: The Pebble Throne
race.penguins.pitch: They already colonized the iceball you filtered out.
race.crows.name: The Open Murder
race.crows.leader: Keeper of the Cache, Kestra Nightcache
race.crows.pitch: Your tech is in circulation. They are the circulation.
race.chickens.name: The Pecking Order
race.chickens.leader: Prime Rooster Cluckett of the Ninth
race.chickens.pitch: Someone has to build the galaxy. They voted, by pecking, that it would be them.

special.old_nest.name: Old Nest
special.old_nest.tip: The first colony here is handed a low tech you do not have.
special.pretty_rocks.name: Pretty Rocks
special.pretty_rocks.tip: +5 credits a turn. Shiny, and annoyingly liquid.
special.rude_wealth.name: Rude Wealth
special.rude_wealth.tip: +10 credits a turn. The soil is showing off.
special.kind_soil.name: Kind Soil
special.spare_nest.name: Spare Nest
special.spare_nest.tip: The first colony starts at two pop.
special.yard_scrap.name: Yard Scrap
building.grand_nest.name: Grand Nest
building.grand_nest.tip: The capital. It counts for more than it should, and it knows.
building.the_yard.name: The Yard
building.boot_barracks.name: Boot Barracks
building.boot_barracks.tip: A garrison, and a slow refill of marines.
building.feed_hall.name: Feed Hall
building.feed_hall.tip: Food, from a building, if the climate will not.
building.research_roost.name: Research Roost
building.horizon_perch.name: Horizon Perch
building.horizon_perch.tip: Three launchers of whatever you currently believe in.
building.colony_mantle.name: Colony Mantle
building.colony_mantle.tip: A shield for the nest. Bombardment is halved.
building.richer_dirt.name: Richer Dirt
building.richer_dirt.tip: Farmers, fed better by the dirt itself.
building.second_clutch.name: Second Clutch
building.second_clutch.tip: Growth, up by half, on this colony.
building.tireless_picks.name: Tireless Picks
building.tireless_picks.tip: Robots. They do not call in sick, and they do not start religions.
building.loud_abacus.name: Loud Abacus
building.loud_abacus.tip: Scientists, plus a machine that interrupts them productively.
building.more_perch.name: More Perch
building.more_perch.tip: One more pop per size, on this world.
building.talon_batteries.name: Talon Batteries
building.talon_batteries.tip: Four heavy Talons, aimed by a planet.
building.seed_exchange.name: Seed Exchange
building.gravity_manners.name: Gravity Manners
building.gravity_manners.tip: The gravity penalty on this world packs up and leaves.
building.night_lab.name: Night Lab
building.night_lab.tip: Ten research, whether or not anyone is on shift.
building.climate_lever.name: Climate Lever
building.ugly_perch.name: Ugly Perch
building.ugly_perch.tip: A gun platform with a shield. Ships built here cost less.
building.flock_brain.name: Flock Brain
building.flock_brain.tip: Scientists here, up by two each.
building.storm_mantle.name: Storm Mantle
building.deep_scratch.name: Deep Scratch
building.second_shift_hall.name: Second Shift Hall
building.second_shift_hall.tip: The night crew does not care about your narrative arc.
building.roost_gate.name: Roost Gate
building.roost_gate.tip: One turn between any two gates you own. The map does not grow a road.
building.departure_roost.name: Departure Roost
building.departure_roost.tip: The door out. Starting it is announced. Finishing it is the victory.
filler.trade_goods.name: Trade Goods
filler.trade_goods.tip: Converts half of industry output into credits.
filler.research_project.name: Research Project
filler.research_project.tip: Converts half of industry output into research.
notify.starvation: The granary is a rumour. {place} is losing people.
notify.strike: The treasury hit the floor. Industry sulks next turn.

hull.huge.name: Albatross
hull.titan.name: Titan Perch
role.talon_line.name: Talon Line
role.talon_line.tip: Beams. They want the middle of the strip.
role.beak_line.name: Beak Line
role.beak_line.tip: Kinetics. They want the short end of the strip.
role.horizon_boat.name: Horizon Boat
role.horizon_boat.tip: A hull that tells the truth about what you think combat is.
role.swat_escort.name: Swat Escort
role.swat_escort.tip: It shoots the mail. Bring it when the autopsy said Horizon.
role.boot_ship.name: Boot Ship
role.nest_ship.name: Nest Ship
role.stake_ship.name: Stake Ship
role.stake_ship.tip: A claim with fuel range attached.
role.glance.name: Glance
role.glance.tip: Eyes. Auto-explore is the point of it.
part.wick_talon.name: Wick Talon
part.wick_talon.tip: A small light with opinions. It starts fights and finishes none.
part.sun_quill.name: Sun Quill
part.sun_quill.tip: Fusion, written in a straight line.
part.banded_glare.name: Banded Glare
part.banded_glare.tip: It arrives in stripes. The stripes are not decorative.
part.last_glare.name: Last Glare
part.last_glare.tip: The evening-ender. The Guardian still flies the original.
part.peck_driver.name: Peck Driver
part.peck_driver.tip: A small hard opinion. Best delivered personally.
part.clatter_bill.name: Clatter Bill
part.gizzard_bore.name: Gizzard Bore
part.gizzard_bore.tip: It grinds. Range is a courtesy it declines.
part.anvil_beak.name: Anvil Beak
part.anvil_beak.tip: The shot has read about gravity and taken it personally.
part.hatch_dart.name: Hatch Dart
part.hatch_dart.tip: The first thing a navy learns to throw away.
part.ink_dart.name: Ink Dart
part.cited_dart.name: Cited Dart
part.indoor_torpedo.name: Indoor Torpedo
part.indoor_torpedo.tip: Unlimited, every other round. Indoor voices were requested.
part.primary_mount.name: Primary Mount
part.primary_mount.tip: Twice the space, half again the anger, and the falloff finally behaves.
part.swat_mount.name: Swat Mount
part.swat_mount.tip: It shoots the mail before the mail arrives.
part.walk_drive.name: Walk Drive
part.walk_drive.tip: Map 2, combat 1. You are walking, and everyone can see it.
part.current_drive.name: Current Drive
part.current_drive.tip: Map 3, combat 2. A polite speed, until someone leans on it.
part.fold_drive.name: Fold Drive
part.fold_drive.tip: Map 4, combat 2. Space, pinched, and the pinching is licensed.
part.migration_drive.name: Migration Drive
part.migration_drive.tip: Map 6, combat 3. The victory drive is this one.
part.pinfeather_plate.name: Pinfeather Plate
part.pinfeather_plate.tip: Hull at face value. A suggestion of armour.
part.joined_plate.name: Joined Plate
part.joined_plate.tip: Seams, done properly. Half again the hull.
part.keel_plate.name: Keel Plate
part.keel_plate.tip: Twice the hull. The bone, worn on the outside.
part.marrow_plate.name: Marrow Plate
part.marrow_plate.tip: Dense enough that the drive notices.
part.unsinkable_plate.name: Unsinkable Plate
part.unsinkable_plate.tip: Three and a half times the hull. The vote has been noted.
part.dust_cover.name: Dust Cover
part.dust_cover.tip: Class 2. Stops a rude remark, and very little of a missile.
part.half_mantle.name: Half Mantle
part.half_mantle.tip: Class 4. Wings at half. The shot pays a toll.
part.full_mantle.name: Full Mantle
part.full_mantle.tip: Class 6. Most of the evening stays outside.
part.closed_season.name: Closed Season
part.closed_season.tip: Class 9. Nothing in season may be shot.
part.pecking_logs.name: Pecking Logs
part.predictive_peck.name: Predictive Peck
part.predictive_peck.tip: The shot leads the duck. The ducks have written.
part.grudge_ledger.name: Grudge Ledger
part.preened_cognition.name: Preened Cognition
part.preened_cognition.tip: The ship thinks. The union has questions.
part.nest_pod.name: Nest Pod
part.nest_pod.tip: A colony, packed. Spent on landing.
part.perch_pod.name: Perch Pod
part.perch_pod.tip: A claim, and the fuel range that comes with it.
part.boot_pod.name: Boot Pod
part.boot_pod.tip: Four marines. The can is not the argument.
part.glance_pod.name: Glance Pod
part.rude_sun.name: Rude Sun
part.rude_sun.tip: Bombardment, doubled. Stacks to triple if you are that kind of guest.
part.very_polite_warhead.name: Very Polite Warhead
part.very_polite_warhead.tip: It observes the forms. Then it is a sun.
part.roost_bracing.name: Roost Bracing
part.roost_bracing.tip: Half again the hull, and no apology.
part.miss_field_1.name: Miss Field I
part.miss_field_1.tip: Incoming Horizon is less convinced, by 20.
part.miss_field_2.name: Miss Field II
part.miss_field_2.tip: Incoming Horizon is less convinced, by 40.
part.loadout_glance.name: Loadout Glance
part.loadout_glance.tip: +10 accuracy, and you may read their design.
part.lean_in.name: Lean-In
part.crop_tanks.name: Crop Tanks
part.crop_tanks.tip: +3 fuel range. The frontier moves out by three.
part.self_sealing_nest.name: Self-Sealing Nest
part.self_sealing_nest.tip: The ship apologises to itself and continues.
part.gone_to_molt.name: Gone to Molt
part.gone_to_molt.tip: Untargetable in rounds 1 and 2. You may still fire. This is legal.
part.not_this_feather.name: Not This Feather
part.not_this_feather.tip: A quarter of the shots were confident about a bird that had stepped aside.
part.orn_plating.name: Orn-Plating
part.orn_plating.tip: Salvaged from a guardian who had a prior appointment with your century.
notify.colony_founded: Colony founded at {place}. It is already hungry.
notify.nest_waiting: Nest Ship at {colony} is waiting for colony population to reach {min_pop}.
notify.nest_drained: Colony drained 1 pop to launch a nest ship.
ui.fleet.doomstack_tip: You may rename it back. Brenda will not respect the rename.
refuse.design_drive: A design must have exactly one drive.
refuse.design_slot: At most one plate, mantle, or computer slot allowed.
refuse.design_mount: Mounts can only be placed on Talon weapons.
refuse.design_loot: Loot parts are only available to the looting empire.
refuse.design_in_use: Design is currently in production or in use.
refuse.out_of_range: Destination is out of fuel range.
refuse.not_habitable: Planet is not habitable for this species.
refuse.no_pod: Fleet does not contain a colonization or outpost pod.
refuse.not_here: Fleet is not in orbit of the target planet's star system.
battle.plan.swat.tip: Swat Priority: Determines whether Swat mounts intercept incoming missiles or fire at enemy ships.
role.horizon_line.name: Horizon Line
role.horizon_line.tip: Missiles. They want the far end of the strip.
